setup_logging_with_config: setup logging using a JSON config file and a save directory for log output
setup_logging_default_level: setup logging with a default log level when no config file is available
setup_logging_handlers: setup logging handlers that write log files to a custom save directory path
review_setup_logging: review the setup_logging function to understand how it loads and applies a JSON logging config
refactor_setup_logging: refactor setup_logging to accept a configurable default log config path instead of a hardcoded one
